ideas.pitch: Real-time coastal erosion and high-wave risk forecasting system tailored for Kerala beaches using satellite data and computer vision.
ideas.title: KeralaCoastalShield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the local context of a beach hackathon in Kerala, addressing real environmental challenges relevant to local authorities, aligning with the pattern of hard engineering and practical monitoring demonstrated by GeoNex-ATLAS.

ideas.pitch: Transparent peer-to-peer catch pricing and demand forecasting platform for local fishermen and coastal markets in Thrissur.
ideas.title: LocalFishPriceEngine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly impacts the local coastal economy of Kerala, giving judges an immediately relatable community impact project with a working end-to-end pricing workflow.

ideas.pitch: Gamified coastal waste collection tracker utilizing image recognition to verify plastic types and reward volunteers instantly.
ideas.title: BeachCleanupLedger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines computer vision classification with an engaging front-end demo that works live on mobile cameras during judging, matching the winning live-demo execution pattern.

ideas.pitch: Automated berth scheduling and cargo vehicle queue prediction tool for regional shipping and fishing harbors.
ideas.title: PortLogisticsOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous time-series forecasting and regression modeling to port logistics, echoing the technical depth of the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner.

ideas.pitch: IoT-connected water usage and greywater recycling monitor designed specifically for coastal tourism properties in Kerala.
ideas.title: ResortWaterAudit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a critical sustainability pain point for Kerala's massive tourism industry, appealing to judges looking for commercially viable green tech solutions.
